messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20-2: The reporting service is a the Dune team service.
- [2026-06-01] standup/ember/2026-06-01: For newcomers: the deploy window for the reporting service is still on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2026-04-13] standup/ember/2026-04-13-2: Ember still owns the reporting service, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-03-26] standup/dune/2025-03-26: Reminder that the reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. Observation from team Dune: after the cache change, the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week.
- [2025-03-20] standup/dune/2025-03-20: Reminder: the reports pipeline is owned by Dune.
- [2026-04-14] standup/dune/2026-04-14-2: The Dune team noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.
- [2025-06-24] standup/dune/2025-06-24: Reporting still relies on Ledger; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2025-01-21] standup/dune/2025-01-21: Dependency map update: reporting needs the ledger service (the nightly balance export).
- [2025-12-05] handover/2025-12-05-reporting: From today the pager for reporting rings the Ember team, not the Dune team. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-09-23] standup/dune/2025-09-23: Reporting switches from Ledger to the bus as its source. Why: the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. Reporting no longer depends on Ledger.
- [2026-05-28] standup/ember/2026-05-28: Ember noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.
- [2025-04-15] standup/dune/2025-04-15: The reports pipeline must stay on Python 3.11 until the pandas 3 upgrade lands.
- [2025-04-29] standup/ember/2025-04-29: The scheduler still relies on the feature flag service; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2025-02-07] standup/ember/2025-02-07: Dependency map update: scheduler needs the feature flag service (per-job kill switches).
- [2025-04-07] standup/ember/2025-04-07: Per the change policy, the webhooks service deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC. Heads-up from the Ember team: the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.
- [2025-11-04] standup/ember/2025-11-04: The Ember team saw that the billing service's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-02-18] standup/ember/2025-02-18: Per the change policy, auth-gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2025-07-21] standup/ember/2025-07-21: Ember runs its planning on Fridays.
- [2025-03-17] standup/cinder/2025-03-17: The catalog service can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.
- [2025-02-11] standup/boreal/2025-02-11: If the event bus is down, the notification service is down: it relies on it for delivery events.
- [2025-02-06] standup/ember/2025-02-06: Deploys to the job scheduler happen on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC and at no other time.
- [2025-12-25] standup/atlas/2025-12-25: Atlas saw that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change; not their service, so they flagged it. Atlas has moved to the second floor.
- [2026-03-20] standup/boreal/2026-03-20-2: Observation from the Boreal team: after the retention change, the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent. The Boreal team runs its planning on Thursdays.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20: The job scheduler lives with the Ember team. For the record, the authentication gateway is owned by Ember.
- [2025-08-19] standup/dune/2025-08-19: The job scheduler's deploy window changes today: it is now on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC. The old slot (Tuesdays 13:00-15:00 UTC) is retired.
- [2026-03-03] standup/cinder/2026-03-03: The auth gateway deploy window (unchanged): on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2025-12-29] standup/dune/2025-12-29: Observation from team Dune: after the client rollout, the event-bus' request volume halved.
- [2025-01-29] standup/ember/2025-01-29: The weekly architecture review is run by Oskar.
- [2025-07-17] standup/atlas/2025-07-17: The ledger remains a Atlas service.
- [2025-01-09] standup/atlas/2025-01-09-2: Dependency map update: billing-api needs Ledger (invoice postings).
- [2025-02-06] standup/ember/2025-02-06-2: Team Ember now does pairing on every production change.
- [2025-01-30] standup/cinder/2025-01-30: If the catalog service is down, the search indexer is down: it relies on it for product documents.
- [2025-12-01] standup/boreal/2025-12-01: Heads-up from Boreal: the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.

Question: Which service does reporting depend on now?
